title: The Miteler Rebbe Explains Your Intimacy, Money, and Food Addictions - Thursday: Maamar Yafeh Sha'ah Achas #3
blurb: You Can't Just Tell an Addict to Stop. You're Asking Them to Die. This Chabad Chassidic discourse is the ultimate manual for healing trauma, addiction, and emotional pain. This is the third of a series of classes on the Maamar (discourse) Yafeh Sha'ah Achas (מאמר יפה שעה אחת) by the Miteler Rebbe, published in Maamarei Admur Haemtzarei (מאמרי אדמו"ר האמצעי קונטריסים). The class was presented by Rabbi YY Jacobson on Thursday, 2 Kislev, 5787, November 12, 2026. Why would an intelligent, decent, loving person risk destroying their marriage, family, reputation, finances, and everything they cherish for a few moments of pleasure? Why can food, money, sexuality, or other compulsive behaviors become so overwhelmingly powerful that even the most devastating consequences cannot stop us? In this extraordinary Chassidus class, the Mitteler Rebbe takes us beneath the surface of addiction and exposes its deepest psychological and spiritual roots. The real issue is not simply the food, the money, or the sexual gratification. It is that somewhere along the journey of life, we have learned to associate certain experiences, substances, behaviors, or relationships with our very sense of being alive. They have become our oxygen, our emotional ventilator, our source of vitality. Without them, we feel as though we are suffocating. title: Before Drawing Conclusions From the Rebbe’s Letters…
blurb: When the Rebbe says something at a Farbrengen, and certainly when the Rebbe writes to a specific person or entity, it must be taken in the right context and background. A Shliach wanted to make a teen hub for teenagers who would likely never attend a regular program. What would this hub be for? What would its hours be? Who would it be open to? What would be done there? All of this is not said.
